name: Katei Kyoushi ~Ryoujoku Lesson~
original_name: 家庭教師～陵辱レッスン～
source:
Sister-in-law requests main character's help as tutor. She can not even guess what kind of character is hidden behind hero's innocent eyes. Her beautiful mother will also make a delicious prey.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
义姐请主人公帮忙担任家庭教师。她根本想象不到，那双天真无邪的眼睛背后隐藏着怎样的人格。就连她美丽的母亲，也会成为可口的猎物。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
